integrity_statement: The stationary law, age hierarchy, heavy-tail constants, and inverse binomial transform are proved within stated hypotheses. The finite consistency script supplements but does not certify the infinite-limit proof. Literature-wide independent priority confirmation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite number of independent one-dimensional symmetric strictly alpha-stable drivers, 0<alpha<2.
Poisson clock independent of states and trajectories, i.i.d. nonempty batch sizes and uniform subsets.
Asymptotic joint displacement tails; no finite-sample inference guarantee or Gaussian alpha=2 claim.
Nonempty batches are essential for identifying all batch-size probabilities from dimensionless tail ratios.
title: Hidden multi-particle tail hierarchy identifies random batch-reset laws for stable flights
